about_the_game:
Seven tracks of transformation and transcendence. Produced by Yurii Radko with a powerful final mix by Surcutt-P, this soundtrack is the emotional core of HYPERxFANTASY—a sonic ritual of becoming something beautifully other.

From the melancholic beauty of leaving prescribed existence behind to the soaring finale of complete metamorphosis, each track charts a journey through liminal spaces where old boundaries dissolve. Haunting ritualistic vocals echo ceremonies of chosen identity. Hypnotic meditations give way to primal combat drums. Guest vocalists Marianna Rudakevych and Japanese artist nanakö lend their ethereal voices to pivotal moments, embodying a fluid quality that defies categorization.

The soundtrack flows through contrasting emotional landscapes—isolation and liberation, conflict and acceptance, the profound quiet of vast spaces and the explosive joy of self-realization. More than background music, these compositions form an essential part of the HYPERxFANTASY experience, equally powerful as a standalone listening journey.
